parameters.name: vs
parameters.description: singlet scalar VEV v_s [GeV], free parameter of eq.(17)

parameters.name: thetaHS
parameters.description: h-S mixing angle theta [rad], free parameter of eq.(17); tan(2 theta) of eq.(14)

parameters.name: lamS
parameters.description: singlet quartic lambda_S in mass-eigenstate parameters

parameters.name: lamPhi
parameters.description: Higgs quartic lambda_Phi in the paper convention (lambda_Phi = 2 lam of SM.fr)

parameters.name: kapXh
parameters.description: kappa_chi chi h [GeV] = -m_h^2 Sin[theta]/v_s, appendix A

parameters.name: kapXH
parameters.description: kappa_chi chi H [GeV] = +m_H^2 Cos[theta]/v_s, appendix A

lagrangian_terms.name: LH2Kin
lagrangian_terms.expression: 1/2 del[H2, mu] del[H2, mu] - 1/2 MH2^2 H2^2

lagrangian_terms.name: LChiKin
lagrangian_terms.expression: 1/2 del[Chi, mu] del[Chi, mu] - 1/2 Mchi^2 Chi^2

lagrangian_terms.name: LS
lagrangian_terms.expression: muS2/2 Scbar Sc - lamPS PhiCbar[ii] PhiC[ii] Scbar Sc - lamS/2 (Scbar Sc)^2

lagrangian_terms.name: LPotCorr
lagrangian_terms.expression: -muH^2 Phibar[ii] Phi[ii] + lam Phibar[ii] Phi[ii] Phibar[jj] Phi[jj] + muPhi2/2 PhiCbar[ii] PhiC[ii] - lamPhi/2 PhiCbar[ii] PhiC[ii] PhiCbar[jj] PhiC[jj]

lagrangian_terms.name: LGaugeH2
lagrangian_terms.expression: DC[PhiCbar[ii], mu] DC[PhiC[ii], mu] - DC[Phibar[ii], mu] DC[Phi[ii], mu]

lagrangian_terms.name: LYukCorr
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{sp, ii, jj, cc, ff1, ff2, ff3, yuk1, yuk2}, yuk1 = ExpandIndices[-yd[ff2, ff3] CKM[ff1, ff2] QLbar[sp, ii, ff1, cc].dR[sp, ff3, cc] PhiC[ii] - yl[ff1, ff3] LLbar[sp, ii, ff1].lR[sp, ff3] PhiC[ii] - yu[ff1, ff2] QLbar[sp, ii, ff1, cc].uR[sp, ff2, cc] PhiCbar[jj] Eps[ii, jj], FlavorExpand -> SU2D]; yuk2 = ExpandIndices[-yd[ff2, ff3] CKM[ff1, ff2] QLbar[sp, ii, ff1, cc].dR[sp, ff3, cc] Phi[ii] - yl[ff1, ff3] LLbar[sp, ii, ff1].lR[sp, ff3] Phi[ii] - yu[ff1, ff2] QLbar[sp, ii, ff1, cc].uR[sp, ff2, cc] Phibar[jj] Eps[ii, jj], FlavorExpand -> SU2D]; (yuk1 + HC[yuk1]) - (yuk2 + HC[yuk2])]

lagrangian_terms.name: LTotal
lagrangian_terms.expression: LH2Kin + LChiKin + LS + LSoft + LPotCorr + LGaugeH2 + LYukCorr
